title: CSCI 331 — Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
subject: Computer Vision
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of an AI system pipeline, including representation, supervision, and decision rules.
Explain how computer vision techniques process image evidence to extract geometric, appearance, and motion information.
Apply a structured problem-solving method to evaluate AI system performance under varying conditions like viewpoint, lighting, and data shift.
